pages.text: Observe infected hosts feeding and growing. Digestion and competing tissue change the organs, silhouette and abilities. For research, let a useful organ mature, weaken its host and consume it. A plain kill does not register a consume sample.

Hosts can evolve after assimilating multiple distinct mature organs. For the story, follow the escape trail from a quarantine post. Hunt Evolved for a ganglion; raid a hive for living hive tissue. The two materials serve different routes.
